title: Convert input text into numerical value
goal: Converts the two weighing readings in the form into numbers and then calculates the total weight.
summary: input box is a string. Number can convert numeric literals to numeric values, as well as empty strings to 0. Once the two conversions are complete, + performs numerical addition.
tasks: Convert firstText and secondText into numerical values ​​within the curly brackets of sumWeights. The argument is a non-negative text or empty string, and the number may have spaces around it.
uses return to return the sum of two readings. Empty readings are calculated as 0.
hint: Both parameters need to be converted. As long as one of the + items is a string, the result will be concatenated into text.

example.note: temperature panel changes the read text into a value of 18.5, which can then be compared with the temperature threshold.
